name: Inselnova
summary: The year is 1247. A vast frontier of scattered islands lies unclaimed — connected only by open sea and the ambitions of those bold enough to sail it. In Inselnova, you are a governor. You start with a single island and a handful of resources, then build farms, mines, and barracks, research technologies, and raise armies and fleets. Raid your neighbours, spy on their defences, trade on a player-driven marketplace, or forge alliances and dominate the rankings. Rule through council affairs that shape your realm’s identity, sail on branching story expeditions, and discover gods whose blessings and curses can turn a war. Builds and research run on real-time timers that keep going while you are offline — a slow-burn game made for short sessions and long progression. No downloads, no pay-to-win. A modern reimagining of the classic German island-warfare game Inselkampf, built for mobile and desktop alike.
